issue.title: Session-page migration rejects legacy agents manifests and blocks all bob-cli hood publication
issue.description: Commit 7cb8359534 (sase-17m.9, September 25) added sessions/<global-session>.md to hood_file_set, but existing manifests with explicit files lists contain only families/<global-session>.md. load_validated_publication compares every existing owner/hood against the new set and fails before any unrelated hood can publish. Direct read-only reproduction on October 3 at SASE b2c1f58528 raises manifest file set mismatch for bbugyi200.apollo.d. Its snapshot digest is valid; the sole missing expected entry is sessions/bbugyi200.apollo.d.md. There are 56 affected hoods across Apollo (2), Athena (52), and kellys_mbp (2). Apollo bob-cli has 370 failed requests, 368 retired. Prompt archives continue reaching GitHub but agents/ last changed September 25. Implement backwards-compatible validation/migration with a cross-owner legacy-manifest regression test, then provide safe reconciliation/backfill of missing pages and recovery of retired requests without losing deferred prompt work. The precise cause is known and bounded, hence medium size. Do not treat --drop-retired as recovery or assume --retry-quarantined revives terminal items. Full evidence is attached.

task_type_fields.impact: All new bob-cli hood publication is blocked by unrelated legacy records from multiple owners; prompt-only pushes mask the outage and hundreds of agent publication requests are retired.
task_type_fields.repro: Open the bob-cli agents sidecar through sase repo open; invoke load_validated_publication on that path using current SASE modules. It raises AgentsSyncFormatError for bbugyi200.apollo.d. Compare the legacy files list with hood_file_set of the digest-valid snapshot: only the new sessions path is missing.

issue.creation_reason: Investigating whether bob-cli publishes its agents revealed a deterministic compatibility regression introduced by the family-to-session rename, with hundreds of failed publication requests.

payload.description: This phase introduced commit 7cb8359534, which adds session paths to expected legacy manifest file sets.
Different manifest failure: byte-limit exhaustion versus the new legacy session-path mismatch; both block hood publication.
Slim-manifest recovery touches the same manifest validation and recovery paths; legacy explicit file lists still block bob-cli.
Published run-state staleness predates this outage; recovery here restores publication but does not add terminal-state refresh triggers.
Records bob-cli owner queue, archive metadata hashes, source counts, and remote cutoffs before recovery
Final remote reconciliation and recovery evidence for the linked bob-cli publication defect
Corrected final reconciliation report for the bob-cli publication recovery

payload.entry: Fixed by epic sase-1fs. Legacy family-only explicit manifests are accepted through Rust classify_session_manifest_files while the sunset flag agents_session_manifest_compat is on (removal tracked by sase-1ft). On 2026-10-05, load_validated_publication of bob-cli agents origin/main 68c0b39 accepted all 660 hood snapshots (slim 551, current 54, supported_legacy 55, invalid 0). apollo.d, the hood named in the original repro, is now a slim entry. 462 of 463 baseline publication-request identities have an agent README or session page. The remaining identity, bbugyi200.athena.0f6, has no publishable runs and no archive bytes. Retired-request recovery landed in b51df19d88.
